Class BinaryTree<T extends Comparable<T>>

java.lang.Object
BinaryTree<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of elements maintained by this tree. Must implement Comparable.
public class BinaryTree<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Object
A generic implementation of a Binary Search Tree (BST). Allows insertion, deletion, searching, and hierarchical string representation of elements.

  • Method Details

    • insert

      public void insert(T value)
      Inserts a new value into the binary search tree. If the value already exists, it will not be inserted again.
      Parameters:
      value - The value to insert.

    • search

      public boolean search(T value)
      Searches for a specific value within the binary tree.
      Parameters:
      value - The value to search for.
      Returns:
      true if the value is found, false otherwise.

    • delete

      public void delete(T value)
      Deletes a specific value from the binary tree if it exists.
      Parameters:
      value - The value to be removed.

    • draw

      public String draw()
      Generates a string representation of the tree showing its hierarchy. The tree is displayed rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise.
      Returns:
      A formatted multi-line string representing the tree structure.

    • serialize

      public String serialize()
      Serializes the binary tree into a string format for network transmission. Format: value(left_subtree)(right_subtree). Empty nodes are represented as (). Example: A root of 5 with children 3 and 8 becomes: 5(3()())(8()())
      Returns:
      The serialized string representation of the tree.
